contract: docs/plans/ui-console-redesign-design.md: same panels/data/actions in three persistent themes, no scan/API/remount on theme changes; inspectable endpoint/rule evidence and scalable manifest navigation.

accessibility.evidence: Chrome Selenium exercises native dialog Tab cycle, Escape and focus return, invalid/denied preference storage and reduced-motion computed styles. Token contrast measured from rendered CSS: minimum tested text/risk ratio 4.985, control boundaries 3.464, focus 7.371; primary controls >=44px. Keyboard bounded table region and unique search/select labels inspected. This is not a screen-reader certification.

responsive.evidence: All three themes at exact CDP viewports 390x844,1024x768,1440x900 retain the same table DOM/content/panels and have no page-level horizontal overflow. Inventory precedes summary on narrow layouts; wide positions differ as approved. Long paths/multiple owners wrap inside the evidence drawer. Tables scroll locally. 22 injected test-only manifests exercise searchable navigation and fixed General access.

loading.evidence: Delayed latest-inventory response shows descriptive loading placeholder and nonfabricated KPI skeletons in all three themes.

empty.evidence: Empty temporary database shows no-scan explanation and existing topbar scan action in every theme.

error.evidence: Controlled 500 TEST_ERROR response shows the exact inventory error and enabled reload action in every theme. Review regression verifies live evidence closes on error/disconnect before previous-snapshot data can replace it.

partial.evidence: Seeded partial snapshot keeps available endpoints and explicit inventory-incomplete/no-disappearance conclusion warning in every theme.

success.evidence: Seeded TCP/UDP endpoints remain separate, with raw severity counts, review state, owners and changes preserved across theme switches. Review/revoke remains one mutation plus refresh; drawer filter/state and running-scan socket counts tested.

permission.evidence: Seeded missing exe/user metadata shows access-denied/unknown distinctly, with multiple owners and a long path fully inspectable; all themes keep the drawer within viewport width. Existing upgrade tests retain gone-state coverage.
